bench_io_writers_fastq.title: IO writers — FASTQ (sync / parallel)
bench_io_writers_fastq.description: FASTQ writer paths. sync vs parallel4 vs parallel8 vs mmap-sink bioseq writers + naive_ofstream baseline. Each iteration writes the corpus, measures, and validates byte-faithful roundtrip via XOR-aggregated content hash. The dna5 SRR file is intentionally NOT included here: the bench's dna4 reader drops 'N's during slurp, so any roundtrip through dna4 is destructive on dna5 input. The reader matrix above keeps the 6 GiB dna5 cell to exercise mmap-parallel + parallel-gzip throughput; the writer matrix sticks to dna4-only corpora for byte-faithful roundtrip.
